Settlement Distance
Sets the minimum distance between Settlements.
Less
2 tiles.

More

Settlement Limit
Sets the initial [icon:SETTLEMENT_LIMIT]Settlement Limit for each Age.
A tighter cap on how many Settlements you may hold.[nn][BLIST][LI] Antiquity: 1 Settlement[LI] Exploration: 4 Settlements[LI] Modern: 10 Settlements[/BLIST]
The game's own Settlement Limit.[nn][BLIST][LI] Antiquity: 3 Settlements[LI] Exploration: 8 Settlements[LI] Modern: 16 Settlements[/BLIST]
A looser cap on how many Settlements you may hold.[nn][BLIST][LI] Antiquity: 5 Settlements[LI] Exploration: 12 Settlements[LI] Modern: 20 Settlements[/BLIST]
Set the Settlement Limit for each Age individually.
Sets this Age's Settlement Limit.[n]Follows Settlement Limit; changing it switches Settlement Limit to Custom.
The most Settlements you may hold in this Age.
Independent Amount
Sets the initial number of [icon:INDEPENDENT_POWER]Independent Powers.[n]The map gets as close to this as it can, but may not place exactly that many.
None
0 Independent Powers.
2 Independent Powers per Civilization.
The game's own amount: 3 Independent Powers per Civilization in Antiquity.
4 Independent Powers per Civilization.
Independent Spacing
Sets the minimum distance for Independent Powers.[n]This may impact the total number of Independent Powers.
Less room between Independent Powers, so more of them fit.[nn][BLIST][LI] Antiquity: 4 tiles[LI] Exploration: 3 tiles[LI] Modern: 2 tiles[/BLIST]
The game's own spacing between Independent Powers.[nn][BLIST][LI] Antiquity: the game's default[LI] Exploration: 6 tiles[LI] Modern: 4 tiles[/BLIST]
More room between Independent Powers, so fewer of them fit.[nn][BLIST][LI] Antiquity: 7 tiles[LI] Exploration: 7 tiles[LI] Modern: 5 tiles[/BLIST]
Independent Aggression
Sets how aggressively Independent Powers raid and attack.
Calm
Independent Powers raid less boldly, take longer to build up forces and have fewer defenders.[nn][BLIST][LI] Antiquity: 0 defenders[LI] Exploration: 2 defenders[LI] Modern: 3 defenders[/BLIST]
Standard Independent Power aggression.[nn][BLIST][LI] Antiquity: 1 defender[LI] Exploration: 3 defenders[LI] Modern: 4 defenders[/BLIST]
Raging
Independent Powers raid more boldly, build up forces faster and have more defenders.[nn][BLIST][LI] Antiquity: 3 defenders[LI] Exploration: 5 defenders[LI] Modern: 7 defenders[/BLIST]
World Wonders
Sets whether World Wonders from a previous Age can still be built.
The game's own rules: World Wonders can only be built in their own Age.
Carry Over
World Wonders of previous Ages that nobody built stay buildable in later Ages, with no unlock needed.[n]A few one-time effects tied to a wonder's own Age are not granted.
Crises
Enables or disables all crises.[n]Disabled turns off every crisis in the Crises list.
The crises included in the Crises list below can occur.
No crises occur.
Crisis Timing
Sets when the crises begin.
No crises occur.[n]Set Crises to Enabled to choose a timing.
Early
Each crisis stage begins earlier in the Age.[nn][BLIST][LI] Stage 1: Begins at 50%[LI] Stage 2: Begins at 65%[LI] Stage 3: Begins at 85%[/BLIST]
The game's own crisis timing.[nn][BLIST][LI] Stage 1: Begins at 70%[LI] Stage 2: Begins at 80%[LI] Stage 3: Begins at 90%[/BLIST]
Late
Each crisis stage begins later in the Age.[nn][BLIST][LI] Stage 1: Begins at 85%[LI] Stage 2: Begins at 90%[LI] Stage 3: Begins at 95%[/BLIST]
Sets this Age's Triumph Set.[n]Follows Triumph Set; changing it switches Triumph Set to Custom.
Set the Triumph Set for each Age individually.
